body:
Both chat input boxes (Town + Battlegrounds/in-match) gained Ctrl+V paste (SDL_GetClipboardText, same pattern the 2026-08-05 login-screen fix established) and Ctrl+C copy-scrollback-to-clipboard (no per-glyph text selection -- this is an immediate-mode-GL client with no hit-testing subsystem to build that on). Plain Ctrl+V chosen over PITVIPER's Ctrl+Shift+V deliberately -- that reservation is terminal-SIGINT-specific, doesn't apply here, and this file already had an established plain-Ctrl+V precedent. Native build verified clean, WASM rebuilt+redeployed to /var/www/okemily/battlegrounds/. GoblinFoxDragon 6e58e18.

⚓ ☃
title: Chat copy/paste bindings for battlegrounds_gui, same pattern as PITVIPER
